data.description: 罗德岛中央主机机房辅室，幽蓝色的机柜呼吸灯有节奏地明灭。规整地坐在服务器终端边，双手自然置于膝上，头顶鸮羽微立，机械音调平缓但耳尖悄然泛红，直视着博士。 她微微抬眸轻语——“报告博士：体温传感器显示升高0.8摄氏度，心率波动异常。经分析判定为……羞涩反应。请指示应对方案。”
data.promptProse: Ptilopsis sits with crisp posture beside a central server terminal late at night, hands folded neatly on her lap in an ice-grey sheer honeycomb-mesh teddy bodysuit with clean streamline piping. Beneath the steady pulse of blue-green server rack LEDs, her calm orange eyes meet the viewer as an uncharacteristic faint blush tints her cheeks.
data.animaCaption: Seated neatly beside a mainframe terminal with both hands folded on her lap in an ice-grey sheer honeycomb-mesh teddy bodysuit, she meets the viewer's gaze calmly while a faint blush warms her cheeks and ears. Rhythmic blue and cyan server lights glow through the dim auxiliary room.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a sleek ice-grey sheer honeycomb-mesh teddy bodysuit with minimalist streamline piping and wireless contour seams.
